rationale: The recorded register trajectory and retained step and reversal timestamps license plotting submitted priority through those windows. This claim requires neither process-output measurements nor conversion to delay.

signal_basis.exact_text: Record the output trajectory through the transient and the later window, and retain the step and reversal timestamps.
The archived trajectory is the smoothed submitted-priority register in command units.
The register records submitted input, not queue state, completion times or application to work items.
